units.source_text: 起初，我是把夫人当作有理解力的女性来对待的，在谈话过程中，我发现她的神情渐渐变了。

en.t: At first, I treated the lady as a woman of understanding, but as we talked I noticed that her expression was gradually changing.

units.source_text: 夫人虽然在向我的头脑倾诉，却开始打动我的心了。

en.t: Although she was appealing to my mind, she had begun to move my heart.

units.source_text: 虽然夫人觉得自己和丈夫之间没有任何隔膜，也不应该有隔膜，却又分明有着什么，

en.t: She felt that there was no barrier between herself and her husband, and that there ought not to be one, yet there was clearly something there.

units.source_text: 然而她睁大眼睛想仔细看个究竟时，还是什么也没有。

en.t: Yet when she opened her eyes wide and tried to see exactly what it was, there was still nothing there.

units.source_text: 这就是令夫人深感痛苦的症结所在。

en.t: That was the core of what caused her such deep suffering.

units.source_text: 起初，夫人断言先生是以厌世的眼光观察社会，因而也厌弃了她。

en.t: At first, she insisted that Sensei viewed society with a world-weary eye, and that as a result he had come to reject her as well.

units.source_text: 夫人虽然这样断言，却又不能淡然处之，追根究底，她从相反的角度来思考了，

en.t: Even though she asserted this, she could not take it calmly; when she thought it through, she began to consider it from the opposite side.

units.source_text: 推测大概是先生由于厌弃她，最终发展到厌弃社会了。

en.t: She guessed instead that Sensei had first come to dislike her, and that this had finally grown into a rejection of society itself.

units.source_text: 可是无论怎样费尽心思，她也找不到事实来佐证这个推测，

en.t: But no matter how hard she strained her mind, she could find no facts to support that guess.

units.source_text: 先生对她向来温柔体贴，作为丈夫无可挑剔。

en.t: Sensei had always been gentle and considerate toward her, beyond reproach as a husband.

units.source_text: 将这个疑团用日复一日的夫妻之情包裹起来，悄悄地埋在心底的夫人，那天晚上，在我面前把这个包裹打开了。

en.t: Having wrapped this doubt in the day to day affection of married life and quietly buried it deep in her heart, she opened that bundle before me that night.

units.source_text: 夫人问，“他是因为我才变成那样的，还是像你所说的，是人生观什么的促使他变成那样的？

en.t: she asked. Did he become that way because of me, or, as you say, was it something like his view of life that made him that way?

units.source_text: 请你毫不隐瞒地告诉我吧。”

en.t: Please tell me without hiding anything.
